ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE

STUDY 149
Rhinestone Script Top & Cargo Pants
Rights check
Source: 25046.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black hair
wears a black knit beret and small wire glasses. She
wears a navy long-sleeve off-shoulder top with
rhinestone script across the chest and white side
stripes, over a white camisole. A gingham blue
waistband peeks under a white drawstring tie on black
cargo trousers. A silver shoulder bag hangs at her side.
Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio
light. Palette of navy, white, and silver. Bold and playful,
in the style of a Y2K streetwear lookbook.
Bold, playful, sporty
WORKING NOTES
- The rhinestone script and beret are the signature styling.
- Keep the rhinestone detail generic to avoid readable text
in the image.
Try this: Keep the rhinestone detail generic, without
readable text.
